paragraph: A gorilla who was once orphaned and rescued has given birth in the wild. She is one of the first eastern lowland gorillas ever to be successfully returned to her habitat. The infant was born on May 21st in Virunga National Park, a protected area in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Her mother learned to live there again after humans raised her and taught her the skills she needed. Every new gorilla infant matters for conservation. This one carries something extra from a mother who found her way back.
